description: The system shall provide an e-commerce platform allowing customers to browse and purchase clothes online, including seasonal collections (winter, summer, and rainy season wear).

title: The website shall segment clothing catalogs by target demogr
description: The website shall segment clothing catalogs by target demographics: Children & Teenagers (ages 0–18, boys and girls) and Young Adults (ages 18–30).

title: The application shall prompt the user to sign in with their
description: The application shall prompt the user to sign in with their Google account when they attempt to like/favorite a product or initiate a checkout purchase.

title: The home screen and product catalog pages shall be publicly
description: The home screen and product catalog pages shall be publicly accessible without requiring user authentication. Guest users can freely view products.

title: The application shall support Google Single Sign-On (OAuth 2
description: The application shall support Google Single Sign-On (OAuth 2.0 Google Account login) allowing users to authenticate quickly without manual email registration.

title: The platform shall provide distinct category navigation for
description: The platform shall provide distinct category navigation for Shirts, T-Shirts, Jeans, Nightwear, and Office Wear with dedicated catalog view pages.
